description: Export one frame of a sequence as an image (Export Frame): PNG, JPEG, TIFF, BMP, DPX, GIF, EXR or TGA, chosen by the file extension. Size defaults to the sequence frame size

outputFile.description: Absolute path; the extension picks the format

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

time.description: Sequence time in seconds. Default: the playhead

name: export_frame
title: Export Frame
